Class GeoUtil

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.geometry.GeoUtil
public final class GeoUtil extends Object
Shared numerical constants and array utilities for the geometry package.

This class centralizes the small tolerance used throughout the package for "effectively zero" comparisons, so that Vector, Line, Plane, and others share a single definition rather than each declaring their own copy. It also hosts the general-purpose array arithmetic that is not specific to three-dimensional geometry.

The class is non-instantiable and contains only static members.

Author:
heddle

    • scalarMultiply

      public static double[] scalarMultiply(double[] vector, double scalar)
      Multiplies every element of an arbitrary numeric vector by a scalar.

      This utility is for array-based vector data, not necessarily for 3D geometry vectors.

      Parameters:
      vector - the array to multiply
      scalar - the scalar multiplier
      Returns:
      a new array containing the scaled values
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if vector is null

    • addVectors

      public static double[] addVectors(double[]... vectors)
      Adds one or more array-based vectors element by element.

      This utility is for array-based vector data, not necessarily for 3D geometry vectors. All arrays must have the same length.

      Parameters:
      vectors - the arrays to add
      Returns:
      a new array containing the element-wise sum
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no arrays are supplied or if the arrays do not all have the same length
      NullPointerException - if vectors or any array in it is null
